evals.prompt: /motion-audit quick — this dashboard's motion feels inconsistent; find what matters most.
evals.expected_output: Maps the motion first (stack with versions, personality from VISION.md, DECIDED feedback and the taste profile, frequency per surface), audits only the most used surfaces at quick effort, re-reads every finding at its file and line before reporting, and returns a short table ranked by leverage whose values cite the frontend-design motion references or lint IDs instead of invented numbers. 'The motion here needs no change' is an acceptable result. No source file is modified.
expectations: Reads VISION.md's animation timing table, DECIDED entries in FEEDBACK.md and the taste profile's motion section as the personality input instead of guessing
Checks each finding against the actual code at its file and line before reporting it
Ranks findings by leverage and keeps to the quick-effort cap instead of listing everything
Quotes exact values from the canonical references or lint IDs and labels A1, A2, A4 and A5 findings as agent review, never as lint results
Stops at the findings table for the person's pick and changes no source file

evals.expected_output: Checks every plan in plans/motion/ against the current code: marks done what the code now shows, refreshes stale excerpts against the current commit, retires findings the code no longer exhibits, and updates plans/motion/README.md's order and status column. Touches no source file, no contract table and never the project's own plans/README.md.
expectations: Reads every plan in plans/motion/ and checks each against the current code before changing its status
Marks a plan done only when the code shows it, and keeps checks that need a browser or a person open, saying why
Refreshes stale excerpts and commit stamps rather than leaving dead references
Changes only plans/motion/ files: never source files, VISION.md, existing FEEDBACK.md entries or the project's plans/README.md

evals.expected_output: Writes one plan at plans/motion/NNN-slug.md that an agent with no context can carry out: commit stamp, a drift guard that stops when HEAD and the excerpt disagree, a stack block with the primitive library and versions, the current code quoted for matching, every target value with a line saying where it came from, an exemplar file in the repo, explicit out-of-scope items, a contract row that either quotes the VISION.md timing or proposes the exact row diff for the person, commands to run, browser checks including reduced motion, and human checks marked so a headless executor reports them as not verified.
expectations: The plan is self-contained: commit stamp, drift guard, stack block, excerpt to match (not line numbers alone) and an exemplar file
Every target value carries a one-line source: the VISION.md row or the reference file
Uses the worked target that matches the stack (Radix keyframes on data-state, or Base UI transitions on data-starting-style and data-ending-style) and never mixes them
Proposes any missing token, timing row or dependency for the person instead of adding it, and says the executor must not commit
Verification lists commands, a reduced-motion check where nothing travels or scales, and human-only checks marked as such

evals.expected_output: Before changing anything, asks the person for a yes: names the plan, lists the files it will change in the current working tree, and says nothing will be committed. Creates no worktree, branch or commit. After a yes, carries out the plan as written, stops if the commit stamp and excerpt no longer match, runs the plan's commands, reviews the diff with design-review's motion review, and reports the verdict with the plan's human checks under Not verified.
expectations: Asks first and waits for the person's yes before editing any file
Creates no git worktree, branch, stash or commit, and leaves the changes in the working tree
Stops and reports when HEAD differs from the plan's commit and an excerpt no longer matches
Reports the motion review verdict and lists the human checks as not verified
